import os,glob,re

    return G

def load():

    return G

    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); O=[r[:] for r in I]
    pts=[(i,j,I[i][j]) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    res=[[I[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
    # collect all segment cell sets (interior only, k=1..L-1), plus target cell marker
    segs=[]
    for (i,j,c) in pts:
        di,dj=VECS[c]; L=max(abs(di),abs(dj))
        sx,sy=(1 if dj>0 else -1, 0) if dj!=0 else (0, 1 if di>0 else -1)
        path=[]
        kk=1
        while True:
            p,q=i+sx*kk,j+sy*kk
            if not(0<=p<H and 0<=q<W) or I[p][q]!=0: break
            path.append((p,q)); kk+=1
            if abs(kk-1)<L and False: pass
        # limit to L steps max
        path=path[:L]
        segs.append((path,c))
    # find crossings: cell in >=2 paths, with paths NOT overlapping an original cell
    occ=defaultdict(list)
    for path,c in segs:
        for (p,q) in path: occ[(p,q)].append(c)
    X=set()
    for (p,q),cl in occ.items():
        if len(cl)>=2: X.add((p,q))
    # paint: each path paints up to first crossing-or-original; crossing cell gets 4 and stops the path
    for path,c in segs:
        for k,(p,q) in enumerate(path):
            if (p,q) in X:
                res[p][q]=4; break
            res[p][q]=5
        else:
            pass
    for (i,j,c) in pts:
        di,dj=VECS[c]
        ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
        if 0<=ni<H and 0<=nj<W and I[ni][nj]==0: res[ni][nj]=c
    return res
